title: The comic triptych
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptional full-fidelity desktop homepage UI comp for the real UNO multiplayer card game, 1440x900 landscape viewport. The attached screenshot is ONLY a reference for the original comic character identities, hand-inked illustration vocabulary, cream/ink/native-card-color palette and lettering; radically replace its composition with the precisely specified three-panel layout below. The whole output is the interface itself, straight on, no laptop frame, no browser chrome, no perspective.

Surface structure in reading order: a compact red italic UNO wordmark at x80 y55, right side simple outlined gear icon and SETTINGS. Warm cream full-bleed background #fff4d6, no black surrounding frame or giant cream poster card. Under the header centered modest condensed italic black text 'Your table. Your rules.' with generous breathing room. Main content is THREE equal strong vertical comic mode panels across the center, x90 to1350, consistent 28px gaps, top y235 bottom y710, readable hierarchy. Left primary panel vivid yellow #ffce00, middle vivid red #df0735, right vivid blue #075bee. Each panel has crisp 3px almost-black ink outline, subtle 8px corners and printed-ink grain kept restrained. Their internal native UNO-like white oval motif tilts gently diagonally, integrated behind character illustration rather than generic abstract decoration. Native card silhouette remains upright in page, a functional interface with clear controls.

One original comic character peeks from the top half of each panel and holds a small fan of UNO cards: left blue rabbit in red hoodie, middle joyful red panda in yellow hoodie, right green crocodile in blue hoodie. Preserve the identity, palette and confident ink contour of the supplied reference. Characters are large but contained inside each mode panel, no crowd and no shared wood table. Each character occupies upper 60% of its panel, separated clearly from the lower action text. Lower quarter has semantic launch label rendered in Barlow Condensed extra bold italic all-caps: left 'PLAY WITH BOTS' in black, middle 'CREATE A ROOM' in cream, right 'JOIN A ROOM' in cream. Large clear outlined right-arrow icon beneath or beside each action, 44px minimum touch target. Under main panels, a single restrained inline footer centered with 'Set up bots' plus small robot icon and 'How to play' plus small book icon, separated by generous space. UI text uses Outfit where not condensed display.

The interface should feel authored, confident, sharp and immediately actionable, controlled ink outlines and thoughtful whitespace. Three modes have equal footprint with yellow left mode clearly first in hierarchy. Compact red branding, no huge title dominating screen. No fake player counts, claims, statistics, prices, dates, promotional badges, extra navigation or invented copy. No AI gradients, translucent glass, soft dashboard tiles, floating orbs, decorative shadows, invented mascots, or giant cream surrounding poster frame. Final image is the full polished home UI, all exact text legible.
